evaluation_basis: Assessed as the first frozen 30-candidate source-derived tournament, using its own pre-registered chronological, cost, sample, breadth and drawdown gates.
original_objective: Translate supplied ICT/TTrades/M1Trades material and causal Ichimoku concepts into explicit multi-timeframe rules and select at most one forward-PAPER research candidate.

engineering_result.summary: The educational sources were converted into a frozen causal registry and executed under one next-open cost/risk contract with immutable result files.

scientific_result.summary: No candidate satisfied all frozen pre-test requirements simultaneously; attractive isolated final-test results could not override failed validation and sample gates.

economic_result.summary: Five candidates had positive validation expectancy, but none cleared the complete eligibility contract. H4 candidates later failed untouched test behavior; two positive daily test results were ineligible.

limitations: Consumed final tests cannot be reused for tuning
contribution_to_next_version: Established a machine-readable strategy registry and exposed the need for broader sources, explicit multiplicity control and external-venue replication in v0.20.
